about:
Hi! I'm Zunaira, a third-year Computer Engineering student at the University of Toronto. My main interests lie in embedded systems and machine learning, and I am eager to explore how the two solve real-world issues!


Throughout courses, design teams, and personal projects, I have been able to develop skills in APIs, data processing, developing, and much more. I am always eager to explore new concepts and technologies, aiming to understand how new tools can be used to solve complex problems.
